title_en: Sermon on the Death of the Holy Three Young Men
author: Cyril of Alexandria
occasion: A timely occasion has arisen to bring remembrance of good martyrs; the text does not specify a particular memorial day.
argument: Cyril urges his hearers to honor the three young men as martyrs and confessors of Christ even before the incarnation. He states that the providence of the holy Trinity worked for the sake of the royal children of the same race, Ananias, Azarias, and Misael. He intends to explain their way of life, advocacy, alliance, and perfection for the Church of God. He says he encountered the testament of Daniel and wrote down the symbol and way of life of the holy children and their perfection in Christ. He closes by praying that the Church may flourish through their intercession and that parents and young people may imitate their virtue.

outline.move: Cyril introduces the timely occasion and calls the congregation to honor the martyrs who confessed Christ before the incarnation.
He names the three young men and states his intention to explain their way of life, advocacy, alliance, and perfection for the Church of God.
Cyril identifies himself as bishop of Alexandria, says he encountered the testament of Daniel, and says he wrote down the symbol and way of life of the holy children and their perfection in Christ.
He prays for the Church's growth and for parents and young people to imitate the children's virtue, noting their feast on December 17.

cast.who: One of the three holy young men commemorated in the sermon.

cast.who: One of the three holy young men commemorated in the sermon.

cast.name: Daniel
cast.who: The all-wise prophet named in the title; in the body Cyril says he encountered the testament of Daniel.

key_terms.sense: Witnesses or martyrs who confessed Christ even before his incarnation.
Confessors, those who openly acknowledged Christ.
Way of life or conduct, especially the virtuous life of the holy children.
Perfection or completion, especially their perfection in Christ.
Festal assembly or celebration, compared to the heavenly orders.
Intercession or advocacy, especially of the martyrs for souls.
Prize or reward, here the reward associated with the martyrs.
Nobly victorious, an epithet for the martyrs.
Advocacy or forensic skill, perhaps the children's defense of their faith.
Alliance or support, perhaps their alliance with God or each other.
Testament or covenant, here the testament of Daniel which Cyril encountered.

scripture: The sermon refers to the prophecy of Daniel and the three young men. Use Septuagint book names and numbering: Daniel, and the Song of the Three Young Men as found in the LXX additions to Daniel. Cite as Daniel and the Prayer of Azariah or Song of the Three Young Men in modern editions.
uncertain: The exact date of composition is not stated in the source.
The precise occasion beyond the timely opportunity for commemorating martyrs is not specified.
The exact relationship between the testament of Daniel and the material Cyril says he wrote down is not fully clear from the source.

_unresolved_facts.claim: He states that the providence of the holy Trinity worked for the sake of the royal children of the same race
_unresolved_facts.source_quote: περὶ τούτων ἡ πρόνοια τῆς ἀχράντου Τριάδος διὰ τῆς ἀρτίως ἀναγνωσθείσης προφητείας, ἕνεκεν τῶν βασιλικῶν ὁμοφύλων παίδων
_unresolved_facts.fix: He states that the providence of the holy Trinity concerning them [the martyrs] was through the prophecy just read, for the sake of the royal children of the same race

_unresolved_facts.claim: He says he encountered the testament of Daniel
_unresolved_facts.fix: He says he came upon / met with the testament of Daniel (ἔτυχον with dative suggests happening upon or encountering, but the context implies engagement with Daniel's testament/covenant rather than merely finding it)

_unresolved_facts.source_quote: Τελειοῦνται δὲ οἱ ἅγιοι παῖδες μηνὶ δεκεμβρίῳ ιζʹ
_unresolved_facts.fix: noting their completion/martyrdom on December 17 (τελειοῦνται means they are perfected/completed, i.e., martyred, not their 'feast')

_unresolved_facts.claim: Daniel ... in the body Cyril says he encountered the testament of Daniel
_unresolved_facts.source_quote: ΚΥΡΙΛΛΟΥ...ΛΟΓΟΣ ΕΙΣ ΤΗΝ ΤΕΛΕΥΤΗΝ ΤΩΝ ΑΓΙΩΝ ΤΡΙΩΝ ΠΑΙΔΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΤΟΥ ΠΑΝΣΟΦΟΥ ΔΑΝΙΗΛ
_unresolved_facts.fix: Daniel is named in the title as co-subject of the sermon ('and of the all-wise Daniel'), not merely 'named in the title' as if incidental; the body mentions 'the testament of Daniel'
